06.
2. Heard Mr. S.K. Sahoo, learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr. S.N. Nayak, learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State and Mr. N.C. Sahoo, learned counsel for opposite party no.5.
3.

The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction to the opposite parties not to acquire the land of the petitioner without following due procedure of law and to pay the compensation of Rs.10.00 lakhs for forcible acquisition.

4. Mr. S.N. Nayak, learned Additional Standing Counsel referring to paragraph-5 of the counter affidavit contended that the land of the petitioner has not yet been acquired and the notification under section 11 (1) of the said Act has not yet been published.
5. In view of the above, this writ petition stands disposed of in view of the statement made in paragraph-5 of the counter affidavit.

JUDGE Arun/Kishore (G. SATAPATHY)
 JUDGE Kunjaram Oram vs State Of Odisha And Others ..... ...
